components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action control; electric fill, directional accent shadow, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #5B8CFF; color: #08090D; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -14px rgba(91,140,255,0.65); transition: background .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform .3s, box-shadow .3s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7AA2FF; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 22px 46px -14px rgba(91,140,255,0.8); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; hairline border on near-transparent fill, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); color: #F3F5FB; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 9999px; transition: border-color .3s, background .3s, transform .3s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form input on graphite ground; accent border on focus, mono label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #B7BECF; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #08090D; color: #F3F5FB; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 12px; caret-color: #7AA2FF; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7C8296; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #5B8CFF; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Raised content surface; tonal elevation, hairline border tightening to accent on hover.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: rgba(14,16,23,0.65); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; transition: transform .3s, border-color .3s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: #7C8296; } .ds-card-title { margin: 16px 0 8px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #F3F5FB; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: #B7BECF; }

components.name: Blueprint Coordinate Mark
components.description: Per-section wayfinding tick: mono coordinate + measured rule, in place of an eyebrow label.
components.css: .ds-coord { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-coord-id { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(122,162,255,0.9); } .ds-coord-rule { height: 1px; width: 56px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255,255,255,0.09), transparent); }

components.name: Header Nav Link
components.description: Top-nav link; Chalk-dim to Chalk on hover, pill hit area.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #B7BECF; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #F3F5FB; }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a precision instrument panel viewed under low light: a graphite drafting surface marked with hairline technical grids, coordinate ticks, corner registration marks, and monospace annotations, with one electric-blue signal that carries every action and highlight. The page argues by being the artifact — an agency proving competence through the craft of its own site. Density alternates deliberately between oversized editorial headlines with generous negative space and compact technical readouts. Glow is controlled and directional, never an ambient neon wash.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite near-black ground with a single committed electric-blue accent.
Hairline blueprint grids and mono coordinates as load-bearing material, not decoration.
Editorial display type (Bricolage Grotesque) against a clean workhorse body (Hanken Grotesk).
One authored entrance motion per section; controlled directional glow.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Electric blue is the only action color. If more than a small fraction of a screen carries the accent, it stops reading as signal — violet and cyan exist so atmosphere never has to borrow the action color.

rules.name: The Off-White Rule
rules.body: Text is Chalk (#F3F5FB), never pure white; borders are the single line value, never a heavier stroke to force emphasis.

rules.name: The Mono-is-Measurement Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only for coordinates, spec labels, data, and measurement — never as a costume to make prose look technical.

rules.name: The Directional-Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow is always a shadow with offset and blur, tied to a real object. Ambient page glow is a low-opacity blurred field behind the grid, never an edge halo.

dos: Do keep the accent scarce (#5B8CFF) — actions, one highlighted word, ticks, gauges.
Do signal elevation tonally first (Ink to Ink-800/700/600) and add Lift only for genuinely floating panels.
Do use JetBrains Mono strictly for coordinates, labels, data, and measurement.
Do give each section one authored entrance (exponential ease-out) with a reduced-motion fallback.
Do vary composition — editorial columns, bento spans, alternating rows — instead of a uniform card grid.
donts: Don't use gradient text; emphasize with weight, scale, or the accent.
Don't place an eyebrow/kicker above a heading — the blueprint coordinate tick is the only pre-heading mark.
Don't thicken borders past the single line hairline, and never use a colored side-stripe.
Don't let glow become ambient neon.
Don't introduce a second action color; violet and cyan stay atmospheric.
